rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.shortDescription: City skyline views, 35 SQM, King Bed
rooms.description: Designed for the modern traveler, our Superior Rooms blend comfort with contemporary elegance. Enjoy breathtaking views of the city skyline while relaxing in a space defined by soothing earth tones and premium furnishings. The room features a plush King-sized bed with high-thread-count linens, a dedicated workspace, and a marble bathroom with a rain shower.

rooms.name: Deluxe Ocean View
rooms.description: Wake up to the rhythm of the waves. The Deluxe Ocean View rooms offer a panoramic spectacle of the Indian Ocean. Spacious, airy, and flooded with natural light, these rooms are a sanctuary of calm. Featuring a private balcony perfect for sunset cocktails, a spacious seating area, and a luxury bathroom with a deep soaking tub.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.description: The pinnacle of opulence. Our Executive Suite is designed for those who demand the exceptional. Featuring a separate living room, a dining area for six, and a master bedroom with a walk-in closet. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the Executive Lounge and personalized butler service ensuring every request is met with precision.

diningOptions.name: Harbour Court
diningOptions.description: A culinary theatre where the world's finest flavors take center stage. From the spice markets of India to the trattorias of Italy, Harbour Court offers an interactive dining experience with live cooking stations and an expansive international buffet.

diningOptions.name: Yue Chuan
diningOptions.description: Journey to the heart of the Orient. Yue Chuan presents the bold, fiery flavors of Szechuan and the delicate, savory notes of Cantonese cuisine in a setting of refined elegance.

diningOptions.name: The Ocean
diningOptions.description: Fresh from the net to your plate. The Ocean is a seafood lover's paradise where you select your catch and have it prepared exactly to your preference, all while overlooking the azure waters.

experiences.title: Infinity Pool
experiences.subtitle: Aquatic Bliss
experiences.desc: Suspended between the sky and the sea, our edge-less infinity pool offers a swimming experience like no other. Lounge by the water with a cocktail in hand as the sun dips below the horizon.

experiences.title: The Spa
experiences.subtitle: Holistic Wellness
experiences.desc: Surrender to serenity. Our expert therapists use ancient healing techniques and organic products to rejuvenate your body and mind. Choose from a curated menu of massages, facials, and body rituals.

experiences.title: Fitness Studio
experiences.subtitle: Peak Performance
experiences.desc: Maintain your rhythm even while traveling. Our state-of-the-art fitness center is equipped with the latest cardio and strength training machines, offering panoramic views to inspire your workout.

offers.title: Advance Purchase
offers.desc: Plan ahead and secure your sanctuary. Book 14 days in advance to enjoy exclusive savings of up to 20% on our Best Available Rate.

offers.title: Bed & Breakfast
offers.desc: Start your day with a culinary journey. Includes a lavish international breakfast buffet at Harbour Court for two.

offers.title: Long Stay Retreat
offers.desc: Make The Kingsbury your home. Stay 5 nights or more and receive 25% off, plus laundry service discounts.

Great stay, but the check-in process was a bit slow.
The dining experience at Harbour Court was unforgettable.
